name: agent-team
description: Run a repo's work as tracked tickets through a team of single-task agents: run-task orchestrates, pm drafts each ticket as a GitHub issue, and plan, design, build and quality agents work one at a time behind gates. Hooks keep each agent in its write scope, gate ticket stages and verdicts, ask the owner before the ready-for-agent label, and block agents whose mapped knowledge kb stale lists. Active only in repos with .claude/agent-team.json.
